# MFE Manifest — Field Reference

Every field `mfe-manifest.yaml` accepts, derived from the Zod schema that
validates it — descriptions included, which live on the Zod fields themselves.

Generated, because the three hand-written documents that described this
language each fell behind it, most severely the one that called itself the
complete platform contract (finding B5 in
`docs/generator-extraction-plan.md`).

For *why* the manifest is shaped this way, see `docs/spec.md` and the ADRs it
indexes. This page answers only *what is allowed*.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | min length 1 | Unique MFE identifier. Used as the registry key and as the generated class/module name. kebab-case. |
| `version` | `string` | pattern `^\d+\.\d+\.\d+` | Manifest version. Bump on any breaking change to capability inputs or outputs. |
| `type` | `tool` \| `agent` \| `feature` \| `service` \| `remote` \| `shell` \| `bff` | — | Architectural role of this MFE. |
| `language` | `javascript` \| `typescript` \| `python` \| `go` \| `rust` \| `java` | — | Implementation language. Only javascript/typescript generate code today. |
| `capabilities` | object[] | — | The domain and platform capabilities this MFE implements. Drives feature-file generation. |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `framework` | `string` | min length 1 | UI framework. Open string — an unknown value warns rather than failing (ADR-036). Omitted defaults to react. |
| `bundler` | `string` | min length 1 | Build tool. Open string, same policy as framework. Omitted defaults to rspack. |
| `description` | `string` | — |  |
| `owner` | `string` | — | Team or individual responsible. Used for impact analysis (ADR-008). |
| `tags` | `string`[] | — | Arbitrary labels for registry search and impact analysis. |
| `category` | `string` | — | Domain grouping for discovery and the marketplace. |
| `endpoint` | `string` | uri | Base URL this MFE is served from. Also sets the generated dev-server port and the BFF origin. |
| `remoteEntry` | `string` | uri | Module Federation remote entry URL. |
| `discovery` | `string` | uri | URL of the MFE's .well-known manifest, for discovery. |
| `dependencies` | object (runtime, design-system, mfes) | — | Runtime, design-system and federated-MFE dependencies. Versions flow into the generated package.json. |
| `data` | object (sources, transforms, plugins, serve, …) | — | GraphQL Mesh configuration. Its presence is what makes the generator emit a BFF. |
| `providesSlots` | object (id, description)[] | — | Named regions this MFE registers at runtime for others to fill (ADR-058, ADR-067). |
| `performance` | object (caching, observability, rateLimit, filterSchema) | — | Caching, observability and rate-limiting config. Mesh plugins and transforms are derived from it (ADR-027). |
| `transforms` | `string`[] | — | Top-level Mesh transform names. Both the config-key and package spellings resolve (ADR-092). |
| `authorization` | — | — | Reserved. Deferred by ADR-007; accepted and ignored. |
